reason: Machine lens: all removed instructions are real NMOS/65SC12 opcodes with no indexing: STA zp (3c,2b) x5 (&9F,&A0,&B0,&B1,&B6), LDA abs zp_save+18/19/20/21/25 (&BC12-&BC19, 4c,3b) x5 = 35 cycles, 25 bytes, matching the claim; one straight-line path, no branches or labels in the window, A/flags at exit still from LDA zp_save+33. No SMC into restore_game_zp (no label+1/+2 stores, no labels inside it). The relies_on is wrong that only render_bss_zero follows: in the shipping and bench builds sky_off.6502/sky_edges.6502 (sky_take_off, hot, per helicopter) follow at &8E44; I recomputed every branch from zero_render_vars to &9000 in strykers.lst, strykers-debug_lives.lst and the fullredraw listing shifted by -25: no taken branch starts or stops crossing a page except zero_rv_128's BPL (start-up only, stops crossing: faster); no indexed reads of tables inside the moved code. In the gameplay builds (shield.6502 follows) shield_hit's BNE skipped at &8E14 starts crossing a page (+1 cycle when taken, i.e. a hit while invulnerable: rare, far below the 35 saved); zero_rv_128 again stops crossing. Semantics spot-checked: the only symbols at &9F/&A0/&B0/&B1/&B6 are top_palette_value, firing_frame, crtc_start_address_high/low, delta_low/first_mover/target; renderer writes of &B0/&B1 are only buffer_to_view/history_to_view, and history_to_view (apply_entries) always falls through to .scrolled's buffer_to_view slot 2, restoring view_to_buffer slot 2's copy taken just after save_game_zp; game.6502 writers of these are logic routines, not render-path or IRQ ones. Not refuted.
